home.heroTitle: I design software experiences that feel human, clear, and built to scale.
home.heroBody: My name is Ricardo da Costa Ribeiro. I work at Telecommunication Telemor and have experience across IT Infrastructure, DBA operations, and application delivery since 2023. I focus on reliable systems, collaborative delivery, and practical training for teams.
home.storyP1: I started in software driven by curiosity about how systems work under pressure. That curiosity turned into a craft: designing clear architectures, aligning teams, and ensuring delivery stays reliable even when the scope shifts.
home.storyP2: Today I blend hands-on engineering with leadership in product delivery. My focus is building resilient platforms that make customers feel confident and teams feel empowered.
